title: Workplace injury reporting
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Include all relevant details.
3. Record the date and time of the accident.
4. Document the specific location of the accident.
5. Include the names and roles of personnel involved.
6. Detail the sequence of events leading to the accident.
7. Describe the extent of any property damage.
8. Document any injuries sustained and their severity.
9. Note the immediate actions taken in response to the accident.
10. Include witness statements if possible.
11. Indicate if any medical treatment was administered.
12. Record if emergency services were contacted and their response.
13. State whether the accident was preventable.
14. Detail any immediate corrective actions taken.
15. Attach any relevant visual evidence (photos, diagrams).
16. List any equipment or tools involved in the incident.
17. Document the type of accident (slip, fall, machinery malfunction, etc.).
18. Indicate if anyone was moved or transferred to a medical facility.
19.
